knownResults: Complete GSE181897 primary point and interval scores from commit 2a294637; no new independent validation claimed.
purpose: Quantify observed cell-sampling variability and systematic donor-average residuals before choosing a model change.
cohort: All 62 admitted donor pairs; all 11800 frozen genes; all 4938 admitted original cells. No donor, cell or gene exclusions.

bootstrap.method: Within each original donor and condition, multinomial resampling of whole cells with replacement at the same observed cell count. Recompute each RNA library over all20303 sourceRNAfeatures before projecting to panel.
bootstrap.rng: NumPy default_rng, independent SeedSequence([seed, int(donor), codeIndex]) per donor-condition; codeIndex0=control,1=treated
bootstrap.MonteCarloSensitivity: Compute variance and diagnostic coverage independently using each half of the 256 replicates. Do not select a favorable half or seed.

analyses: Exact equal-donor raw-response MSE decomposition into squared donor-average residual and between-donor residual variation. These are descriptive components, not causal attribution.
Coverage and error partition by original control/treated zero/nonzero status; retain all four strata.
Observed-cell bootstrap variance for control and treated log1pCPM and their sum.

Diagnostic-only widening: preserve the original mean, availability mask and Student-t critical value; combine original future-donor variance with estimated control plus treated cell-sampling variance. No nominal calibration claim: this uses held-treated measurements, ignores cross-study exchangeability and cannot estimate genes/states never observed.
Report all donors and both training origins; no new primary acceptance threshold.
limitations: The bootstrap treats sampled cells as exchangeable within donor/condition; technical pools and cell-state composition can violate this.
Observed-cell resampling misses unsampled states and undetected transcripts. Failure of widened intervals cannot rule out sampling noise.
Bootstrap replicates, genes and cells are not new biological donors.
No native predictor, fit, clipping rule, feature panel, uncertainty model or original result is changed.
